Job Description
About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Job Description
Software Engineer I – Campus Hiring Role Join Harness as a Software Engineer I and work on building scalable, reliable software across areas such as CI/CD, Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, Developer Experience, and AI-powered software delivery. You will work closely with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software. Eligibility B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering disciplines. Fresh graduates graduating in 2027. Strong academic and technical fundamentals. Eligible candidates as per the campus-specific placement criteria. Skills Strong understanding of Data Structures & Algorithms. Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming. Proficiency in at least one programming language: Java, C++, Go, or Python. Understanding of DBMS, Operating Systems, and Computer Networks. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good communication and collaboration skills. Familiarity with Git, Linux, REST APIs, cloud technologies, or CI/CD is a plus. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software. Build scalable and reliable products and services. Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code. Debug and troubleshoot technical issues. Participate in code reviews and engineering discussions. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and other cross-functional teams. Learn and contribute to Harness technologies, tools, and engineering practices.

Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Job Description
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

companies.description:
IDFC FIRST Bank's core philosophy follows a customer centric promise Always You First. The bank aspires to provide high quality financial solutions for emerging India, while keeping customer at the core. About your future dream team: Our team is pivotal for delivering the vision – Always You First. This team acts as a center of excellence to provide accurate and timely insights and data driven solutions to drive personalized and innovative product offerings to our customers. At IDFC First bank, we know that not everyone can bring all the skills & experiences to the table, therefore, we are more focused on people bringing a growth mindset to their approach to work. Learning on the job is the way we work, so don’t worry if don’t have all! We work closely with all business units (product, sales), functional stakeholders (e.g. credit, operations, Journey Excellence), technology teams (IT team and vendors) and external partners (e.g. DSAs, agencies) to create and deliver competitive advantage and quantifiable impact on the Bank’s performance. Also, to add, we not only work with traditional data environment of relational databases, SQL/SAS but also in AWS using PySpark, Sagemaker and other Auto – ML tools like Altair. The Purpose The Data Analyst role –  Identifies business needs  Builds advanced analytical ML & DL tools  Develop test strategies  Supports Senior Analysts & Lead Analyst in delivering business outcome Areas that play to your strengths All the responsibilities we’ll trust you with –  Identify and scope business requirements and priorities through rigorous information gathering and analysis as well as clarification of the solutions, initiatives and programs to enable effective delivery.  Design analytics techniques to meet current and future business needs.  Robust understanding of data and fields required or analysis.  Understanding of analytical framework and map it with data available  Develop a test strategy and systematic test procedures to verify and ensure that solution meets its design specifications  Develop, select and apply algorithms and advanced computational methods to enable systems to learn, improve, adapt and produce desired outcomes or tasks.  Displays the ability to approach existing situations and problems in a new manner and creates innovative solutions  Challenges the status quo to bring about continuous improvement in performance, drives changes that would have a positive impact on the organization  Works to achieve goals and objectives and shows a strong drive to follow through and complete what was started.  Recognizes the complex interrelationships among business activities and understands the "big picture" of how decisions impact the overall business, outcomes and processes  Has an innate orientation to be aware of how one contributes to the larger vision of the Bank Things we’ll like about you!  You love problem solving, you have excellent communication skills and you are action oriented (you like doing stuff, not just thinking or talking about them)  You can work with unstructured problem statements (like estimating how many square feet of pizza is consumed in India in a day without looking it up on the internet)  You get excited at the prospect of working with large volumes of data and enjoy coding!  You are open to learning continuously – irrespective of whether it is a new technology, a new algorithm or a new business!  You know when to look things up on the internet!

Job Description
IDFC FIRST Bank's core philosophy follows a customer centric promise Always You First. The bank aspires to provide high quality financial solutions for emerging India, while keeping customer at the core. About your future dream team: Our team is pivotal for delivering the vision – Always You First. This team acts as a center of excellence to provide accurate and timely insights and data driven solutions to drive personalized and innovative product offerings to our customers. At IDFC First bank, we know that not everyone can bring all the skills & experiences to the table, therefore, we are more focused on people bringing a growth mindset to their approach to work. Learning on the job is the way we work, so don’t worry if don’t have all! We work closely with all business units (product, sales), functional stakeholders (e.g. credit, operations, Journey Excellence), technology teams (IT team and vendors) and external partners (e.g. DSAs, agencies) to create and deliver competitive advantage and quantifiable impact on the Bank’s performance. Also, to add, we not only work with traditional data environment of relational databases, SQL/SAS but also in AWS using PySpark, Sagemaker and other Auto – ML tools like Altair. The Purpose The Data Analyst role –  Identifies business needs  Builds advanced analytical ML & DL tools  Develop test strategies  Supports Senior Analysts & Lead Analyst in delivering business outcome Areas that play to your strengths All the responsibilities we’ll trust you with –  Identify and scope business requirements and priorities through rigorous information gathering and analysis as well as clarification of the solutions, initiatives and programs to enable effective delivery.  Design analytics techniques to meet current and future business needs.  Robust understanding of data and fields required or analysis.  Understanding of analytical framework and map it with data available  Develop a test strategy and systematic test procedures to verify and ensure that solution meets its design specifications  Develop, select and apply algorithms and advanced computational methods to enable systems to learn, improve, adapt and produce desired outcomes or tasks.  Displays the ability to approach existing situations and problems in a new manner and creates innovative solutions  Challenges the status quo to bring about continuous improvement in performance, drives changes that would have a positive impact on the organization  Works to achieve goals and objectives and shows a strong drive to follow through and complete what was started.  Recognizes the complex interrelationships among business activities and understands the "big picture" of how decisions impact the overall business, outcomes and processes  Has an innate orientation to be aware of how one contributes to the larger vision of the Bank Things we’ll like about you!  You love problem solving, you have excellent communication skills and you are action oriented (you like doing stuff, not just thinking or talking about them)  You can work with unstructured problem statements (like estimating how many square feet of pizza is consumed in India in a day without looking it up on the internet)  You get excited at the prospect of working with large volumes of data and enjoy coding!  You are open to learning continuously – irrespective of whether it is a new technology, a new algorithm or a new business!  You know when to look things up on the internet!

About the company	1. Vision: To build a world-class Bank in India, founded with principles of Ethical, Digital, and Social Good Banking. 2. Scale: IDFC FIRST Bank is one of India’s fast-growing private banks, building its UI, UX, and tech stack like a fintech. As of June 30, 2026, the Bank has a customer business of Rs. 6,04,776 crore including deposits and loans, with YoY growth of around 20%. 3. Scope: We are a universal Bank offering complete range of services, including Retail, MSME, Rural, Startups, Corporate Banking, Cash Management, Credit Cards, Wealth Management, Deposits, Government Banking, Working Capital, Trade Finance, and Treasury solutions. 4. Ethical Banking: We are committed to doing right even when customers are not watching. We have simplified descriptions, calculations, and legal jargon to avoid confusing customers. 5. Digital Banking: The Bank's modern technology stack delivers high-quality services across all channels like mobile, branch, internet banking, call centers and relationship managers. Built on cloud-native, API-led, microservices architecture, supported with data, analytics, AI, and fine aesthetics, we strive to deliver fintech-grade experiences on banking platform. 6. Social Good: We have served over 40 million customers in inclusive banking, including 3.6 million women entrepreneurs, 7.5 million lifestyle improvement loans, 2 million livelihood loans, 300,000+ SMEs, 2.7 lakh water and sanitation loans, and 2.5 lakh electric vehicles. Our ESG credentials are strong and steadily improving. 7. Customer Friendly Banking: We make banking easy by having a customer first approach. We have waived fees on 36 essential savings account services which are commonly charged in the market, the first and only bank in India to do so. We create “pull” products that customers actively seek out. 8. Governance: We adhere to regulatory guidelines in letter and spirit and actively work with regulators to make things better. We take pride in maintaining highest levels of corporate governance. 9. Shareholders: We are building a well-diversified universal banking portfolio designed to deliver consistent ROE of 16%+. 10. Employees: IDFC FIRST Bank is designed to be a happy place to work, with cutting-edge roles, meaningful growth opportunities, and a culture of meritocracy. Compensation is healthy, efforts are recognized, and employees experience the pride and excitement of creating a world-class Bank in India.

About the company	1. Vision: To build a world-class Bank in India, founded with principles of Ethical, Digital, and Social Good Banking. 2. Scale: IDFC FIRST Bank is one of India’s fast-growing private banks, building its UI, UX, and tech stack like a fintech. As of June 30, 2026, the Bank has a customer business of Rs. 6,04,776 crore including deposits and loans, with YoY growth of around 20%. 3. Scope: We are a universal Bank offering complete range of services, including Retail, MSME, Rural, Startups, Corporate Banking, Cash Management, Credit Cards, Wealth Management, Deposits, Government Banking, Working Capital, Trade Finance, and Treasury solutions. 4. Ethical Banking: We are committed to doing right even when customers are not watching. We have simplified descriptions, calculations, and legal jargon to avoid confusing customers. 5. Digital Banking: The Bank's modern technology stack delivers high-quality services across all channels like mobile, branch, internet banking, call centers and relationship managers. Built on cloud-native, API-led, microservices architecture, supported with data, analytics, AI, and fine aesthetics, we strive to deliver fintech-grade experiences on banking platform. 6. Social Good: We have served over 40 million customers in inclusive banking, including 3.6 million women entrepreneurs, 7.5 million lifestyle improvement loans, 2 million livelihood loans, 300,000+ SMEs, 2.7 lakh water and sanitation loans, and 2.5 lakh electric vehicles. Our ESG credentials are strong and steadily improving. 7. Customer Friendly Banking: We make banking easy by having a customer first approach. We have waived fees on 36 essential savings account services which are commonly charged in the market, the first and only bank in India to do so. We create “pull” products that customers actively seek out. 8. Governance: We adhere to regulatory guidelines in letter and spirit and actively work with regulators to make things better. We take pride in maintaining highest levels of corporate governance. 9. Shareholders: We are building a well-diversified universal banking portfolio designed to deliver consistent ROE of 16%+. 10. Employees: IDFC FIRST Bank is designed to be a happy place to work, with cutting-edge roles, meaningful growth opportunities, and a culture of meritocracy. Compensation is healthy, efforts are recognized, and employees experience the pride and excitement of creating a world-class Bank in India.

Job Description
IDFC FIRST Bank's core philosophy follows a customer centric promise Always You First. The bank aspires to provide high quality financial solutions for emerging India, while keeping customer at the core. The Purpose The Associate Data Scientist-AI supports the design, development, and deployment of Generative AI solutions that enhance business processes, customer experience, and decision-making. The role focuses on building, fine-tuning, and evaluating large language models (LLMs) and other generative models, working closely with senior data scientists, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to translate use cases into scalable AI solutions. Roles & Responsibilities Generative AI Development: • Assist in developing, fine-tuning, and evaluating Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models, embedding models) for business use cases such as text generation, summarization, classification, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). • Implement prompt engineering, prompt optimization, and guardrails to improve model performance, safety, and reliability. • Support experimentation with open-source and commercial GenAI models and frameworks. Data Preparation & Modeling • Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured and unstructured data (text, documents, logs, etc.) to support GenAI pipelines. • Create and maintain feature sets, embeddings, and vector databases for downstream applications. • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns and insights that inform model design. Model Evaluation & Optimization • Define and execute evaluation strategies using quantitative metrics and qualitative assessments (e.g., relevance, accuracy, hallucination rate). • Analyze model outputs, identify failure modes, and recommend improvements. • Support A/B testing and continuous monitoring of deployed GenAI solutions. Deployment & Collaboration • Assist in deploying GenAI solutions into production environments in collaboration with ML engineers and platform teams. • Work with product managers, business analysts, and domain experts to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. • Document models, experiments, and best practices for reproducibility and knowledge sharing. Governance & Best Practices • Adhere to responsible AI, data privacy, and security guidelines. • Support compliance with internal AI governance, ethical AI standards, and regulatory requirements. • Stay up to date with emerging GenAI techniques, tools, and industry trends Skills: • You love problem solving, you have excellent communication skills and you are action oriented (you like doing stuff, not just thinking or talking about them) • You can work with unstructured problem statements (like estimating how many square feet of pizza is consumed in India in a day without looking it up on the internet) • You get excited at the prospect of working with large volumes of data and enjoy coding! • You are open to learning continuously – irrespective of whether it is a new technology, a new algorithm or a new business! • You know when to look things up on the internet!

Company Details :
Company Name	InMobi Privated Limited and Glance Private Limited
Address	3rd, 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th Floor, Block Delta (Block B), Embassy Tech Square, Kadubeesanahalli Village, Outer Ring Road, Varthur Hobli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103 (Both InMobi and Glance)
	
City	Bangalore
Country	India
Zipcode	560103
Website	Glance - https://glance.com/ InMobi - https://advertising.inmobi.com/
Category	Multi National Company (Indian Origin)
Sector	E-Commerce
About the company	InMobi: Building a new company in the recession of 2007 was no ordinary task. Yet with passion and foresight, we charted our course, helping to transform the way consumers engage with their phones. Over the last 17 years, InMobi has built a global Advertising Platform that powers our customers’ growth by helping them engage their audiences and drive real connections. InMobi has also built a second unicorn, Glance, which is advancing digital consumption and creating a new wave of disruption. Present on 400M devices across India, SEA, Japan and the US – Glance is one of the largest content platforms globally with~200M daily active users. Glance: Founded in 2019, Glance is a consumer technology company that operates some of the most disruptive digital platforms including Glance, Roposo, and Glance TV. Glance has redefined the way the internet is consumed on the lock screen, removing the need to search for and download apps. Over 400 million smartphones now come enabled with Glance’s next-generation internet experience.     Roposo has revolutionized commerce by launching a destination for creator-led live entertainment commerce. Glance TV is changing the way consumers engage and interact with their televisions.     Headquartered in Singapore, Glance is an unconsolidated subsidiary of InMobi Group and is funded by Jio Platforms, Google, and Mithril Capital. For more information, visit glance.com, roposo.com, and inmobi.com.

companies.description:
Who We Are Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed. We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise. While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer. Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity What’s In It For U • Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative • Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it. • Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you. • More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent. • Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year. • Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average. • Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally. • Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole. • Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses. • Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus. About the role We are looking for a curious, hands-on Software Engineer who is excited to build reliable applications across the full stack and explore practical applications of artificial intelligence. This role is designed for a recent graduate who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into useful software. What you’ll do Build, test, and maintain user-facing features and backend services. Develop clean, responsive interfaces and well-structured APIs. Work with databases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to application performance and reliability. Explore and integrate AI capabilities—such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or intelligent automation—where they solve real user problems. Write readable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, testing, and technical discussions. Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teammates to deliver features from concept through release. Learn the team’s tools and engineering practices and contribute ideas for continuous improvement. What we’re looking for A 2026 graduate of with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and debugging. Hands-on experience building projects across the frontend and backend through coursework, internships, open-source work, or personal projects. Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (such as React, Angular, or Vue) and one backend language or framework (such as Java/Spring, Python, Node.js, or .NET). Working knowledge of REST APIs, relational or NoSQL databases, Git, and software testing fundamentals. Genuine interest in AI/ML and experience—or a strong willingness to learn—using AI APIs, LLMs, prompt design, embeddings, or related tools. Clear communication, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to learn from feedback. Nice to have Internship, capstone, or personal project experience shipping a full-stack application. Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, or application monitoring. Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs, handling failure cases, and considering privacy, security, and reliability in AI-enabled features. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or project write-up that demonstrates how you approach software problems.

Job Description
Who We Are Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed. We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise. While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer. Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity What’s In It For U • Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative • Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it. • Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you. • More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent. • Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year. • Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average. • Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally. • Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole. • Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses. • Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus. About the role We are looking for a curious, hands-on Software Engineer who is excited to build reliable applications across the full stack and explore practical applications of artificial intelligence. This role is designed for a recent graduate who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into useful software. What you’ll do Build, test, and maintain user-facing features and backend services. Develop clean, responsive interfaces and well-structured APIs. Work with databases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to application performance and reliability. Explore and integrate AI capabilities—such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or intelligent automation—where they solve real user problems. Write readable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, testing, and technical discussions. Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teammates to deliver features from concept through release. Learn the team’s tools and engineering practices and contribute ideas for continuous improvement. What we’re looking for A 2026 graduate of with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and debugging. Hands-on experience building projects across the frontend and backend through coursework, internships, open-source work, or personal projects. Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (such as React, Angular, or Vue) and one backend language or framework (such as Java/Spring, Python, Node.js, or .NET). Working knowledge of REST APIs, relational or NoSQL databases, Git, and software testing fundamentals. Genuine interest in AI/ML and experience—or a strong willingness to learn—using AI APIs, LLMs, prompt design, embeddings, or related tools. Clear communication, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to learn from feedback. Nice to have Internship, capstone, or personal project experience shipping a full-stack application. Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, or application monitoring. Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs, handling failure cases, and considering privacy, security, and reliability in AI-enabled features. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or project write-up that demonstrates how you approach software problems.

In this role, you will be one of the resources in our extended team working out of Mumbai, with an opportunity to be involved in the entire spectrum of activities in a VC fund, as well as work on portfolio-specific business development opportunities. You will be closely involved with portfolio company activities on behalf of the Fund, including business development activities, tracking and monitoring and strategy be reviewing and preparing business plans, performing valuation analysis, assist in providing primary and secondary sources of research, conducting due diligence, preparing investing memos, develop investment theses and deal pipeline through primary and secondary research (including but not limited to industry research, company research, macro research, etc.) meet and source excellent investment ideas (business development), be hands-on in existing deals run by senior deal team members, assist with fund-raising initiatives and investor relations, crucially, you will understand the nuances of early-stage investing.

companies.description:
This position is for a Mixed-Signal engineer who can be trained to eventually lead some of our Analog/Mixed-Signal IC tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Mixed-Signal engineer who can be trained to eventually lead some of our Analog/Mixed-Signal IC tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Mixed-Signal engineer who can be trained to eventually lead some of our Analog/Mixed-Signal IC tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

companies.description:
Embedded Software: Build the firmware that powers next-gen wearables using ultra-low-energy Wi-R wireless technology. �� On‑site – Bengaluru, India | Competitive salary + bonus + early equity ��About Ixana Ixana is a Purdue University spinoff pioneering brain-inspired wearable computing. We've developed Wi-R, a patented communication tech that's 100x more energy-efficient than Bluetooth or WiFi. Join our 60-person team building the next era of real-time, AI-powered human-computer interaction. �� The Wi-R Revolution Wi-R is our patented non-radiative near-field communication technology that creates secure "wire-like wireless" experiences through small E-field bubbles around your body. This breakthrough enables unprecedented energy efficiency at sub-0.1 nanojoules per bit, making long-term wearable and implantable devices finally practical. See Wi-R in action: Visit ixana.ai for demos of high-speed data streaming through skin contact: https://vimeo.com/ixana/pairing-contact-transfer What You’ll Do Write bare-metal C/C++ firmware to interface MCUs with sensors and Wi-R chips. Lead embedded software development for Wi-R reference devices like smartglasses, smartwatches, earbuds, EEG/EMG nodes, and more. Build, test, and debug low level embedded code on custom hardware platforms. Integrate and optimize communication protocols (I2C, SPI, BLE) for wearable use cases. Work closely with hardware and system engineers to iterate on design and bring-up. Help shape and contribute to the new Wi-R embedded software standard. What We're Looking For One of the following must be true: experience writing embedded code for wearable or silicon chip bring-up. Strong experience with MCU firmware development. Low-level coding ability (bare-metal, register-level) and ow-power optimization skills. Familiarity with interfaces like I2C, SPI, BLE, and hands-on debugging. Preferred Qualifications Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and embedded debugging tools. Familiarity with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB. Exposure to personal embedded projects or hardware hacking. PCB design or firmware–hardware co-design experience. Experience working with toolchains, makefiles, and custom build environments. �� Compensation & Benefits • Base salary: Competitive and based on experience • Cash bonus + meaningful early‑stage equity • Relocation bonus, partner job‑search help • Medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, inventor cash awards �� Why Join Us Work on deep tech that matters Collaborate with world-class experts and industry leaders Own your work end-to-end and see real impact Enjoy a culture of speed, rigor, and respect Competitive salary, equity, and global exposure �� Location On-site — Bengaluru, India (Brookefield Mall area). Multiple openings available across experience levels — from fresh graduates to 10+ years of industry experience. ��Application Requirements Resume (Optional) Personal embedded projects or GitHub links Short write-up on an embedded system you've built or contributed to Ready to re‑wire the future of human-computer interaction? Apply via our careers page. In your note, tell us how you envision using Wi‑R to transform everyday experiences—across healthcare, industry, or consumer tech. Ixana is an equal opportunity employer committed to advancing human-computer interfaces through innovative low-power electronics innovation. Keywords: Embedded Systems, Wearables, C/C++, MCU Firmware, Bare Metal, Low-Power Design, Wi-R, Startup, Equity, I2C, SPI, BLE, Embedded Debugging

companies.description:
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

PLACEMENT	IC Design Engineer II	4100000 INR			0.0

Job Description
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

companies.description:
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company, backed by top-tier investors, that is solving India's massive property dispute problem by offering the nation's fastest and most comprehensive property title search engine. Our platform retrieves critical legal documents in seconds, effectively building the operating system for property ownership in India and transforming a $200 billion industry currently responsible for two-thirds of all court cases. Landeed is scaling rapidly, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. The role of an early-stage Software Engineer involves working directly with the founding team to design scalable backend systems, build AI/ML solutions for data extraction and analytics, and create intuitive frontends, requiring strong skills in languages like Python and JavaScript. This is a high-impact, wealth-building opportunity to join the first 50 employees of a fast-growing startup, gain expertise in proptech and legal tech, and directly influence product strategy that impacts millions of Indian families. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

PLACEMENT	Full Stack Engineer	16000000 INR			0.0

Job Description
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company, backed by top-tier investors, that is solving India's massive property dispute problem by offering the nation's fastest and most comprehensive property title search engine. Our platform retrieves critical legal documents in seconds, effectively building the operating system for property ownership in India and transforming a $200 billion industry currently responsible for two-thirds of all court cases. Landeed is scaling rapidly, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. The role of an early-stage Software Engineer involves working directly with the founding team to design scalable backend systems, build AI/ML solutions for data extraction and analytics, and create intuitive frontends, requiring strong skills in languages like Python and JavaScript. This is a high-impact, wealth-building opportunity to join the first 50 employees of a fast-growing startup, gain expertise in proptech and legal tech, and directly influence product strategy that impacts millions of Indian families. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

companies.description:
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company building India's real estate operating system, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. Frontier labs post-train on the open internet; we post-train on data the internet has never seen: handwritten deeds in six languages, regional-dialect voice conversations, survey maps and satellite imagery, and decades of skewed scans. Terra is our multi-agent system where models converse with users in voice and text, read documents and site photos, reason over video and GIS data, and make judgment calls that lenders and families act on. As an AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training) you will adapt open-weight language, vision-language and speech models to Terra, end to end from data curation through training, evals and deployment: SFT and preference optimization (DPO/GRPO-class methods), agentic behaviour tuning (tool use, multi-step reasoning, code-switching across Indian languages), provenance-grounded structured outputs, speech adaptation for Indian languages, GIS and visual grounding, training data pipelines, and evaluation suites that gate releases. We look for strong ML and deep learning fundamentals, solid Python and PyTorch, familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem, and projects, research or internships where the candidate personally fine-tuned or trained a model. This is hands-on training work in production with a small, senior team, working directly with the founders. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

Frontier labs post-train on the open internet; we post-train on data the internet has never seen: handwritten deeds in six languages, regional-dialect voice conversations, survey maps and satellite imagery, and decades of skewed scans. Terra is our multi-agent system where models converse with users in voice and text, read documents and site photos, reason over video and GIS data, and make judgment calls that lenders and families act on. As an AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training) you will adapt open-weight language, vision-language and speech models to Terra, end to end from data curation through training, evals and deployment: SFT and preference optimization (DPO/GRPO-class methods), agentic behaviour tuning (tool use, multi-step reasoning, code-switching across Indian languages), provenance-grounded structured outputs, speech adaptation for Indian languages, GIS and visual grounding, training data pipelines, and evaluation suites that gate releases. We look for strong ML and deep learning fundamentals, solid Python and PyTorch, familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem, and projects, research or internships where the candidate personally fine-tuned or trained a model. This is hands-on training work in production with a small, senior team, working directly with the founders. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

Full-Time | Core Team | Bengaluru LAT Aerospace | Civil, Defence & GTE At LAT Aerospace, we're solving critical aerospace problems in India, for the world, across three programs: regional mobility through short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft, aircraft and drone propulsion through indigenous gas turbine engines, and securing our borders with cutting-edge autonomy and tech aiding our armed forces. We're hiring graduate engineers who want to own a subsystem, not shadow one - pick a problem below and work on it directly inside one of our programs. What you'll work on Aerodynamics - CFD and low-fidelity simulations of blown wing aerodynamics, and flight dynamic models for advanced wing configurations to support STOL constraints GNC - Low-speed control of our aircraft using the distributed propulsion architecture; software and hardware-in-loop simulations to validate control logic Structures - Design, FEA, and testing loops for primary and secondary aircraft structures; integrating powertrain, stacked electric ducted fans, and other components into a reliable airframe Powertrain - Power electronics, controls, thermals, and integration of our hybrid-electric powertrain Gas Turbine Engine - Compressor, combustion chamber, turbines, materials, manufacturing, and FADEC control Autonomy and Defence - CUAS radar, interceptor drones, navigation computers, GNSS-denied operation What we're looking for High action bias - a "getting things done" attitude and confidence tackling varied, tough technical challenges Real depth in at least one of: aerodynamics, structures, GNC, powertrain, turbomachinery, autonomy, electronics. Depth in one beats a shallow pass over all six Evidence that you build things - FSAE, Aero Design, rocketry, hyperloop, UAV or robotics teams, published work, a strong BTP, or a serious personal build. What you did matters more than the team's ranking Comfort with ambiguity - incomplete requirements, changing designs, and decisions made with imperfect data should sound interesting, not alarming Why LAT? Core team opportunity at a high-conviction deep-tech startup Real aircraft, real flying hardware, real impact Ownership from day one - your own analyses, your own components, one desk away from the people making the biggest calls Build the future of sustainable aviation in a secure India

Job Description
Full-Time | Core Team | Bengaluru LAT Aerospace | Civil, Defence & GTE At LAT Aerospace, we're solving critical aerospace problems in India, for the world, across three programs: regional mobility through short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft, aircraft and drone propulsion through indigenous gas turbine engines, and securing our borders with cutting-edge autonomy and tech aiding our armed forces. We're hiring graduate engineers who want to own a subsystem, not shadow one - pick a problem below and work on it directly inside one of our programs. What you'll work on Aerodynamics - CFD and low-fidelity simulations of blown wing aerodynamics, and flight dynamic models for advanced wing configurations to support STOL constraints GNC - Low-speed control of our aircraft using the distributed propulsion architecture; software and hardware-in-loop simulations to validate control logic Structures - Design, FEA, and testing loops for primary and secondary aircraft structures; integrating powertrain, stacked electric ducted fans, and other components into a reliable airframe Powertrain - Power electronics, controls, thermals, and integration of our hybrid-electric powertrain Gas Turbine Engine - Compressor, combustion chamber, turbines, materials, manufacturing, and FADEC control Autonomy and Defence - CUAS radar, interceptor drones, navigation computers, GNSS-denied operation What we're looking for High action bias - a "getting things done" attitude and confidence tackling varied, tough technical challenges Real depth in at least one of: aerodynamics, structures, GNC, powertrain, turbomachinery, autonomy, electronics. Depth in one beats a shallow pass over all six Evidence that you build things - FSAE, Aero Design, rocketry, hyperloop, UAV or robotics teams, published work, a strong BTP, or a serious personal build. What you did matters more than the team's ranking Comfort with ambiguity - incomplete requirements, changing designs, and decisions made with imperfect data should sound interesting, not alarming Why LAT? Core team opportunity at a high-conviction deep-tech startup Real aircraft, real flying hardware, real impact Ownership from day one - your own analyses, your own components, one desk away from the people making the biggest calls Build the future of sustainable aviation in a secure India

About the company	Imagine a world where flying is as easy as taking a bus – where air travel isn't reserved for major cities, but reaches everyone, everywhere. No congested hubs, no security lines, no hours lost in transit. Just seamless, affordable, on-demand flights connecting thousands of destinations the world has overlooked for too long. We're building the future of mass aviation: a network of high-frequency, low-cost, 8-seater STOL (short take-off and landing) aircraft that make every city, town, and community accessible. Our aircraft take off and land from compact "air-stops" no bigger than a parking lot – no baggage belts, no bottlenecks, none of the expensive airport infrastructure that regional travel was never meant to need. But easy flight is the outcome of hard engineering – and that engineering doesn't stop at the airframe. The engine that powers it, the autonomy that flies it, the systems that defend it are all the same problem. So we're building three capabilities India should own itself: Civil: an 8-seater hybrid-electric STOL aircraft, designed ground-up for efficiency and built for affordability. Gas Turbine Engines: world-class gas turbine engines developed in-house, laying the foundations of a true aerospace ecosystem. Defence: sovereign autonomy and defence systems that perceive, decide, and act in the real world. Aerodynamics from first principles. Propulsion built in-house. Autonomy from day one. This isn't the supersonic fantasy you've been sold. It's the aviation our communities actually need.

Full-Time | Core Team | Bengaluru LAT Aerospace | Civil, Defence & GTE At LAT Aerospace, we're solving critical aerospace problems in India, for the world, across three programs: regional mobility through short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft, aircraft and drone propulsion through indigenous gas turbine engines, and securing our borders with cutting-edge autonomy and tech aiding our armed forces. We're hiring graduate engineers who want to own a subsystem, not shadow one - pick a problem below and work on it directly inside one of our programs. What you'll work on Aerodynamics - CFD and low-fidelity simulations of blown wing aerodynamics, and flight dynamic models for advanced wing configurations to support STOL constraints GNC - Low-speed control of our aircraft using the distributed propulsion architecture; software and hardware-in-loop simulations to validate control logic Structures - Design, FEA, and testing loops for primary and secondary aircraft structures; integrating powertrain, stacked electric ducted fans, and other components into a reliable airframe Powertrain - Power electronics, controls, thermals, and integration of our hybrid-electric powertrain Gas Turbine Engine - Compressor, combustion chamber, turbines, materials, manufacturing, and FADEC control Autonomy and Defence - CUAS radar, interceptor drones, navigation computers, GNSS-denied operation What we're looking for High action bias - a "getting things done" attitude and confidence tackling varied, tough technical challenges Real depth in at least one of: aerodynamics, structures, GNC, powertrain, turbomachinery, autonomy, electronics. Depth in one beats a shallow pass over all six Evidence that you build things - FSAE, Aero Design, rocketry, hyperloop, UAV or robotics teams, published work, a strong BTP, or a serious personal build. What you did matters more than the team's ranking Comfort with ambiguity - incomplete requirements, changing designs, and decisions made with imperfect data should sound interesting, not alarming Why LAT? companies.description:
About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Compensation & Perks Total CTC: ₹36 LPA Fixed Pay: ₹15.30 L Variable: ₹2.7 L Joining Bonus (at the time of joining): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 1): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 2): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 3): ₹4 L Retention Bonus (end of year 4): ₹5 L Perks You'll Love: 🧠 Exposure to leaders & steep learning curve ✨ Impact from Day 1 in one of India's fastest-growing startups 🏆 Performance-based growth & ownership 🍕 Food, fun, and vibrant office spaces Why Meesho? Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

Job Description
About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Compensation & Perks Total CTC: ₹36 LPA Fixed Pay: ₹15.30 L Variable: ₹2.7 L Joining Bonus (at the time of joining): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 1): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 2): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 3): ₹4 L Retention Bonus (end of year 4): ₹5 L Perks You'll Love: 🧠 Exposure to leaders & steep learning curve ✨ Impact from Day 1 in one of India's fastest-growing startups 🏆 Performance-based growth & ownership 🍕 Food, fun, and vibrant office spaces Why Meesho? Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

Purpose of Role • Apply widely agreed software engineering principles and methodologies to design, develop, test and maintain applications and services to achieve the stated business and technology goals within required budgets and timelines • The role also entails contribution to project-critical requirements, as a maximum of 30% occupancy of the role, in any other areas of the Software Development Lifecycle. Roles & Responsibilities • Liaises with engineers, architects, business analysts and other key stakeholders to understand the objectives and requirements • Delivers a lasting solution or code within cost and time estimates of the project • Develops high-volume, high-performance, high-availability applications using proven frameworks and technologies • Develops software that is amenable for greater automation of build, release testing and deployment process on all environments • Delivers software components to enable the delivery of bank platforms, applications and services • Writes unit and integration tests, within automated test environments to ensure code quality • Responsible for work quality, ensuring it meets the technical standards for all services output • Continuously invests in learning technology and software development best practices at Natwest • Participate in and complete all the mandatory technical/domain/behavioral/e-learnings organized by the India Technology Academy, from time-to-time. • Understand the business that the role is part of and invest to deep dive in the domain learning for the respective project.
