Associate Product Manager I Location: Bengaluru About the Team Navi’s Product Team builds solutions that are simple, scalable, and centered on real user needs. The team strongly collaborates across functions—engineering, design, data, and business—to turn insight into impact. About the Role This role provides an opportunity for individuals with a foundational understanding of product analysis to contribute to data-driven decision-making and play a vital role in shaping the success of our products. The Product Analyst will work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and contribute to the overall product strategy. What We Expect From You Gather and analyze data to extract insights, providing valuable input for data-driven decision-making. Use SQL for efficient data querying and analysis. Identify and address product-related issues, relying on established procedures for basic problem-solving. Focus on user insights and data analysis for specific product features. Contribute to the understanding of product performance based on data-driven observations. Demonstrate basic awareness of design principles. Show a sense of good vs. bad design. Pay attention to detail in product analysis. Have basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Understand basic feature prioritization, typically guided by senior product management. Communicate clearly with all stakeholders, seeking help from managers in case of blockers or conflicts. Focus on data analysis and reporting to contribute to decision-making processes. Must Haves 0-2 years of relevant experience in product analysis or a related field. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data. Proficient in SQL for data querying and analysis. Basic understanding of user needs and product features. Basic awareness of design principles and the ability to distinguish good vs. bad design. Basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate findings and insights effectively. About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

Software Engineer I Location: Bangalore About Navi We are shaping the future of financial services for a billion Indians through products that are simple, accessible, and affordable. From Personal & Home Loans to UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds, and Gold - we’re building tech-first solutions that work at scale, with a strong customer-first approach. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact. About the Role At Navi, our technology teams build innovative, scalable and intelligent financial products. We leverage software engineering, data science, machine learning and artificial intelligence to solve complex problems across financial services. As an Engineer at Navi, you will solve real-world problems, build technology at scale and develop solutions that deliver measurable customer and business impact. Engineering team at Navi works across following areas: Software Engineering: Build & test scalable applications, backend services, world class Apps, UIs, APIs and distributed systems that delivers Navi's products to customers for powering 4 Billion transactions a month and growing by ~20% month on month. Data Science & Machine Learning: Apply advanced techniques across machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision and Generative AI to solve complex business problems using diverse data. Develop predictive models and intelligent solutions, experiment with emerging approaches, and ensure robust model validation, production monitoring and continuous improvement. GenAI: Build innovative AI-powered applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and agentic AI to develop intelligent chatbots, automate complex workflows and solve real-world business problems. Experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate across teams and deliver scalable, reliable AI solutions that drive meaningful customer and business impact. Data & ML Platforms: Build scalable, cost-efficient infrastructure to collect, process and analyse data through batch and real-time pipelines, enabling self-serve capabilities across Analytics, Data Science and Product. Develop core ML infrastructure, including feature stores, automated training, model serving and real-time monitoring, alongside standalone feature-extraction applications that power Navi’s core technology. What We Expect From You Build and Deliver: Design scalable systems, develop, test and deploy high-quality technology solutions to solve real-world problems. Solve Complex Problems: Apply strong analytical thinking, engineering fundamentals and data-driven approaches to translate ambiguous problems into effective solutions. Explore and Innovate: Experiment with algorithms, architectures and emerging technologies across Software Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, Data Engineering and GenAI. Own End-to-End Outcomes: Take accountability from problem definition and solution design through deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. Collaborate and Learn: Work effectively across teams, exchange ideas, incorporate feedback and continuously strengthen your technical skills. Focus on Impact: Deliver solutions that improve customer experience, system performance, model effectiveness and business outcomes, while upholding the Navi OS. Must Haves Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, proficiency in at least one programming language, and a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to break down complex problems, debug effectively, and develop clean, efficient and maintainable solutions. Strong learning agility, communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to take ownership and adapt to new technologies.

Job Description
Software Engineer I Location: Bangalore About Navi We are shaping the future of financial services for a billion Indians through products that are simple, accessible, and affordable. From Personal & Home Loans to UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds, and Gold - we’re building tech-first solutions that work at scale, with a strong customer-first approach. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact. About the Role At Navi, our technology teams build innovative, scalable and intelligent financial products. We leverage software engineering, data science, machine learning and artificial intelligence to solve complex problems across financial services. As an Engineer at Navi, you will solve real-world problems, build technology at scale and develop solutions that deliver measurable customer and business impact. Engineering team at Navi works across following areas: Software Engineering: Build & test scalable applications, backend services, world class Apps, UIs, APIs and distributed systems that delivers Navi's products to customers for powering 4 Billion transactions a month and growing by ~20% month on month. Data Science & Machine Learning: Apply advanced techniques across machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision and Generative AI to solve complex business problems using diverse data. Develop predictive models and intelligent solutions, experiment with emerging approaches, and ensure robust model validation, production monitoring and continuous improvement. GenAI: Build innovative AI-powered applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and agentic AI to develop intelligent chatbots, automate complex workflows and solve real-world business problems. Experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate across teams and deliver scalable, reliable AI solutions that drive meaningful customer and business impact. Data & ML Platforms: Build scalable, cost-efficient infrastructure to collect, process and analyse data through batch and real-time pipelines, enabling self-serve capabilities across Analytics, Data Science and Product. Develop core ML infrastructure, including feature stores, automated training, model serving and real-time monitoring, alongside standalone feature-extraction applications that power Navi’s core technology. What We Expect From You Build and Deliver: Design scalable systems, develop, test and deploy high-quality technology solutions to solve real-world problems. Solve Complex Problems: Apply strong analytical thinking, engineering fundamentals and data-driven approaches to translate ambiguous problems into effective solutions. Explore and Innovate: Experiment with algorithms, architectures and emerging technologies across Software Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, Data Engineering and GenAI. Own End-to-End Outcomes: Take accountability from problem definition and solution design through deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. Collaborate and Learn: Work effectively across teams, exchange ideas, incorporate feedback and continuously strengthen your technical skills. Focus on Impact: Deliver solutions that improve customer experience, system performance, model effectiveness and business outcomes, while upholding the Navi OS. Must Haves Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, proficiency in at least one programming language, and a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to break down complex problems, debug effectively, and develop clean, efficient and maintainable solutions. Strong learning agility, communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to take ownership and adapt to new technologies.

Job Description
Associate Manager - AI Strategy & Operations (AISO) Location: Bangalore About the Team Navi’s GenAI team is transforming how AI powers financial services in India. We are embedding advanced AI that directly impacts millions of users across Lending, Payments, Insurance, and Investments. As a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers, and product leaders, we work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real business problems—shipping fast, learning constantly, and scaling what works. About the Role The Associate Manager - AISO (AI Strategy & Operations) role is a position focused on executing prompt engineering, testing, and debugging tasks for AI powered applications. The role supports the development and maintenance of AI chatbots and automation use cases under guidance from senior team members. Must Haves ● Strong written and verbal communication skills in English ● High attention to detail and quality ● Logical reasoning and structured thinking ● Ability to analyze text outputs and identify inconsistencies or logical gaps ● Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solution-oriented mindset ● Ability to learn new tools, workflows, and AI concepts quickly ● Comfort working in ambiguous and iterative environments ● Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Preferred backgrounds: Economics, English, Psychology, Marketing, Social Sciences) Preferred Skills ● Exposure to AI tools, chatbots, or LLM-based platforms ● Strong comprehension and critical analysis skills ● Ability to break down complex problems into structured evaluation scenarios ● Familiarity with structured documentation and reporting What You’ll Do ● Develop and iterate prompts for AI based applications. ● Test AI outputs across multiple scenarios, edge cases, and user journeys ● Identify prompt-level failures, hallucinations, and inconsistent behavior ● Analyze interaction logs and transcripts to improve bot accuracy ● Execute bulk testing using internal tools ● Document findings, improvements, and version updates clearly ● Collaborate with AI Scientists, Product Managers, and Engineers to implement improvements What We Expect From You ● High ownership and a proactive approach to solving problems ● Strong written clarity and ability to reason through ambiguity ● Comfort with fast-changing environments and an agile mindset ● Curiosity about AI systems and how large language models behave ● Structured thinking under pressure ● A mindset of continuous improvement and learning About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! To know more about us, our work, people, culture, values etc., check out navi.com/careers. Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/careers/values-at-navi to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

companies.description:
The Applied Scientist at NoBroker.com / ConvoZen.AI will work on the research, development and deployment of advanced AI and data science products impacting millions of users. The role involves conducting research on state-of-the-art AI algorithms, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech-to-Text (STT) and Speech-to-Speech (STS) technologies. The candidate will design, build and deploy scalable end-to-end AI systems, including fine-tuning and optimisation of LLMs and multimodal models for real-time conversational AI applications. The role also involves analysing large and complex datasets to identify opportunities for automation and product optimisation, and collaborating with software engineers, product managers and research scientists to translate research into production-ready features. Candidates may also work on academic collaborations and research publications while leveraging generative AI, distributed systems and modern machine learning frameworks to develop robust and scalable AI solutions.

Job Description
The Applied Scientist at NoBroker.com / ConvoZen.AI will work on the research, development and deployment of advanced AI and data science products impacting millions of users. The role involves conducting research on state-of-the-art AI algorithms, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech-to-Text (STT) and Speech-to-Speech (STS) technologies. The candidate will design, build and deploy scalable end-to-end AI systems, including fine-tuning and optimisation of LLMs and multimodal models for real-time conversational AI applications. The role also involves analysing large and complex datasets to identify opportunities for automation and product optimisation, and collaborating with software engineers, product managers and research scientists to translate research into production-ready features. Candidates may also work on academic collaborations and research publications while leveraging generative AI, distributed systems and modern machine learning frameworks to develop robust and scalable AI solutions.

The AI for Research (AI4R) team leads BR in exploring and applying advanced AI and machine learning to generate novel drug-discovery insights and make discovery faster, smarter, and more focused on patients' needs. We partner directly with drug-discovery teams, raise AI expertise across BR, and stay at the frontier by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry. As an AI Specialist joining early in your career, you will design and build AI that helps discover tomorrow's medicines. You'll work alongside experienced AI engineers, ML-methods researchers, and rapid-prototyping builders on the same class of models and problems that define the field at the world's leading AI labs – but here, pointed at a goal that matters: real therapies for real patients. We don't yet know whether your strengths lean toward engineering robust systems, inventing new ML methods, rapidly building agentic AI workflows, or bridging AI with biology and chemistry to keep the science rigorous – and that's by design. companies.description:
Software Engineer, Gen AI & Robotics About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role You’ll build the software that turns a capable robot into a product customers rely on, from the Claude code like agentic harness, the cloud services and data infrastructure down to the robot software itself. What you’ll work on Physical agentic framework: Build agents that turn a job into a plan of steps, execute each one, verify it against real operating procedures, and escalate to a human when unsure. Build in tool use, memory, failure recovery, and human-in-the-loop handoffs. Cloud planners and fleet orchestration: Build services that break work orders into tasks, schedule them across robot fleets, and track progress and exceptions in real time. Vertical integrations and product: Connect our agents to each industry’s existing systems, such as data center management, ticketing, maintenance workflows, and manufacturing execution systems. Build customer-facing dashboards, job setup, and audit trails. On-robot software and hardware integration: Build the ROS-based stack for perception, control, and task execution. Bring up and integrate robot arms, sensors, cameras, and teleop rigs. Data infrastructure and tooling: Build ingest, storage, indexing, and retrieval for large volumes of multimodal robot data. Build the tools our data operations team uses daily for capture, review, and annotation. Training and evaluation infrastructure: Partner with ML engineers on job orchestration, compute management, and reproducible pipelines. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related branch Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and systems design Fluency in Python and at least one of C++, Rust, Go, or TypeScript At least one substantial project you built and shipped, where other people used it or it ran on something real Preferred Experience building with LLMs and agents: tool use, planning, and agent frameworks Experience with backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP, containers, databases) Frontend experience: you can put a usable UI in front of a backend (React or similar) Experience with ROS or ROS 2, embedded systems, or real-time software Experience with distributed systems or data pipelines (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet) Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects Internships at product companies or startups, or meaningful open-source contributions What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. You’re as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and you’ll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. There’s no playbook. You’ll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. You’ll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

Job Description
Software Engineer, Gen AI & Robotics About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role You’ll build the software that turns a capable robot into a product customers rely on, from the Claude code like agentic harness, the cloud services and data infrastructure down to the robot software itself. What you’ll work on Physical agentic framework: Build agents that turn a job into a plan of steps, execute each one, verify it against real operating procedures, and escalate to a human when unsure. Build in tool use, memory, failure recovery, and human-in-the-loop handoffs. Cloud planners and fleet orchestration: Build services that break work orders into tasks, schedule them across robot fleets, and track progress and exceptions in real time. Vertical integrations and product: Connect our agents to each industry’s existing systems, such as data center management, ticketing, maintenance workflows, and manufacturing execution systems. Build customer-facing dashboards, job setup, and audit trails. On-robot software and hardware integration: Build the ROS-based stack for perception, control, and task execution. Bring up and integrate robot arms, sensors, cameras, and teleop rigs. Data infrastructure and tooling: Build ingest, storage, indexing, and retrieval for large volumes of multimodal robot data. Build the tools our data operations team uses daily for capture, review, and annotation. Training and evaluation infrastructure: Partner with ML engineers on job orchestration, compute management, and reproducible pipelines. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related branch Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and systems design Fluency in Python and at least one of C++, Rust, Go, or TypeScript At least one substantial project you built and shipped, where other people used it or it ran on something real Preferred Experience building with LLMs and agents: tool use, planning, and agent frameworks Experience with backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP, containers, databases) Frontend experience: you can put a usable UI in front of a backend (React or similar) Experience with ROS or ROS 2, embedded systems, or real-time software Experience with distributed systems or data pipelines (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet) Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects Internships at product companies or startups, or meaningful open-source contributions What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. You’re as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and you’ll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. There’s no playbook. You’ll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. You’ll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

companies.description:
About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. You’ll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. PLACEMENT	Machine Learning Engineer, Robotic Foundation Models	3500000 INR
Job Description
About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. You’ll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. What you’ll work on Training and post-training: Train and post-train robotic foundation models, including vision-language-action models, using imitation learning and reinforcement learning. You’ll own the work from data loading through multi-GPU training runs. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. Simulation: Build simulation environments for our tasks. Train policies with reinforcement learning that transfer to real robots. Rewards and verifiers: Design the reward functions and the verifiers that check whether a task step actually succeeded. Evaluation: Build harnesses that tell us whether a model actually got better, in simulation and on real hardware. Design the metrics that decide what ships. Data and data infrastructure: Define what data the models need. Build the pipelines that turn raw robot episodes into versioned, training-ready datasets. Trace a stuck policy back to its data. Models on robots: Get models running reliably and fast enough on real hardware. Debug failures in the lab across the model, the data, and the robot. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related branch Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, optimization, and machine learning Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems Fluency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch or Tensorflow At least one serious ML project you can go deep on: a course project, internship, research, or something you built yourself. Preferred Publications in AI, open-source contributions, or strong competition results (Kaggle, robotics contests) Research or internship experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, or robotics Experience with post-training transformers, diffusion models, or multimodal models Experience with distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed) or GPU performance work (CUDA, profiling) Experience with data pipelines or large datasets (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet, WebDataset) Exposure to robot simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, PyBullet) or real robot hardware Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. You’re as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and you’ll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. There’s no playbook. You’ll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. You’ll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

Job Description
We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief - “Every Day is Game Day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services. ROLE PURPOSE We are hiring for the role of Software Engineer. This is an Individual Contributor role reporting into the Senior Engineering Manager. In your role, you'll be instrumental in advancing our mission by delivering on the end-to-end application, functionality and features as per the project requirements and priorities. You will also be entrusted with ensuring that every feature and functionality of the application is designed, developed, and integrated according to the specified goals and timeline. The responsibilities we entrust you with • Understand the design and project architecture and perform coding and unit testing in accordance with the design and architecture • Understand the issues being reported, analyse the logs and resolve the technical issues through debugging and root cause analysis. • Analyse the trends in issues being reported and troubleshoot issues to determine depth of issues and severity, investigate potential workarounds and take required actions as per defined SLAs • Work with testing team to review test cases, explore opportunities for automation • Document code consistently, analysis findings and benchmark performance as per defined standards • Provide support in the maintenance of test automation scripts and enhancing existing automation scripts to cover the new functionalities WHAT MATTERS IN THIS ROLE • Years of work experience: 0-2 years of experience in software development, including internships. • Qualification: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science (CSE), Information Technology (IT) Experience with Web Services: Consuming or creating web services using REST, MQTT, or Web Sockets. Containerization: Working knowledge of Docker, Rocket, and container orchestrators like Kubernetes and Docker Swarm. Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud services and resources in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Programming and Design: Strong understanding of SOA, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and multi-threaded application development. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Understanding of basic concepts such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Ability to implement simple class structures and relationships. Data Structures (DS) & Algorithms: Familiarity with fundamental data structures like arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and basic operations (insertion, deletion, traversal). Source Code Management: Proficiency in Git or similar distributed SCM tools. WHAT WE VALUE IN OUR PEOPLE : You are the CEO of what you do: You show ownership and make things happen. You own tomorrow: You build solutions for the merchants and do the right thing. You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do.

Job Description
We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief - “Every Day is Game Day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services. ROLE PURPOSE We are hiring for the role of Software Engineer. This is an Individual Contributor role reporting into the Senior Engineering Manager. In your role, you'll be instrumental in advancing our mission by delivering on the end-to-end application, functionality and features as per the project requirements and priorities. You will also be entrusted with ensuring that every feature and functionality of the application is designed, developed, and integrated according to the specified goals and timeline. The responsibilities we entrust you with • Understand the design and project architecture and perform coding and unit testing in accordance with the design and architecture • Understand the issues being reported, analyse the logs and resolve the technical issues through debugging and root cause analysis. • Analyse the trends in issues being reported and troubleshoot issues to determine depth of issues and severity, investigate potential workarounds and take required actions as per defined SLAs • Work with testing team to review test cases, explore opportunities for automation • Document code consistently, analysis findings and benchmark performance as per defined standards • Provide support in the maintenance of test automation scripts and enhancing existing automation scripts to cover the new functionalities WHAT MATTERS IN THIS ROLE • Years of work experience: 0-2 years of experience in software development, including internships. • Qualification: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science (CSE), Information Technology (IT) Experience with Web Services: Consuming or creating web services using REST, MQTT, or Web Sockets. Containerization: Working knowledge of Docker, Rocket, and container orchestrators like Kubernetes and Docker Swarm. Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud services and resources in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Programming and Design: Strong understanding of SOA, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and multi-threaded application development. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Understanding of basic concepts such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Ability to implement simple class structures and relationships. Data Structures (DS) & Algorithms: Familiarity with fundamental data structures like arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and basic operations (insertion, deletion, traversal). Source Code Management: Proficiency in Git or similar distributed SCM tools. WHAT WE VALUE IN OUR PEOPLE : You are the CEO of what you do: You show ownership and make things happen. You own tomorrow: You build solutions for the merchants and do the right thing. You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do.
